title: Catch TypeError for unhashable type arguments in generic model cache
answers: Why does parameterizing a generic BaseModel with unhashable metadata fail with TypeError?
How does Pydantic handle caching of generic models with unhashable type arguments?
Fix TypeError unhashable type when subscripting generic BaseModel with Annotated
body:
Symptom: TypeError: unhashable type when parameterizing a generic BaseModel with unhashable type arguments, such as Annotated containing an unhashable object.
Root cause: pydantic/_internal/_generics.py:get_cached_generic_type_early and pydantic/_internal/_generics.py:set_cached_generic_type accessed _GENERIC_TYPES_CACHE directly using keys containing unhashable type arguments.
Fix pattern: Wrap cache lookups and mutations in pydantic/_internal/_generics.py:_generic_cache_get and pydantic/_internal/_generics.py:_generic_cache_set to catch TypeError, returning None on lookup and skipping cache writes.
Constraints: Applies to internal generic type caching; hashable arguments remain cached normally while unhashable arguments safely bypass the cache without preventing model construction.
applies: Generic BaseModel type caching when parameterized with arbitrary or unhashable type arguments
